digest.component_or_area: DC transport layer / outbound assignee routing
propositions: DC transport._assign passes empty string assignee directly to pycontribs JIRA.assign_issue, which cannot interpret it as an unassign instruction and either raises or assigns an arbitrary user
Cloud transport already routes falsy/empty assignee through unassign_issue instead of assign_issue, but DC transport never received this fix
pycontribs JIRA._get_user_id treats only None (not empty string or -1) as the unassign sentinel and will search_users on empty string, causing unpredictable behavior
The fix maps falsy assignee to None inside DC transport._assign before calling assign_issue, mirroring the Cloud transport's handling
Test test_outbound_unassign_round_trips expects assignee field to be null after local assignee clear converges on DC but fails before the fix
